text: {"label":"Verbal Behavior Field Overviews and Taxonomy","definition":"Broad overviews of verbal behavior as a research area: symposia on recent advances and trends, annotated bibliographies, systematic reviews, reflections on the field's status, and debates over defining and classifying verbal operants.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Surveys and conceptualizes the verbal behavior field as a whole, rather than studying specific relations such as intraverbals, acquisition of particular verbal operants, or nonverbal operant phenomena like behavioral contrast."}
